about_the_game:
Welcome to Dead Freight, a single-player sci-fi delivery van adventure with a morbid twist. Traverse a vibrant and dangerous alien world while transporting a variety of grotesque cargo—from severed limbs to living organs. As you journey between far-flung outposts, you'll uncover the mysteries behind this strange, interconnected ecosystem.

Upgrade your van, balance your load, scan the environment for resources, and survive hostile creatures in a land where everything is alive—and watching.

Deliver the Undeliverable

Haul unsettling parcels across an alien world filled with bizarre flora and fauna.

Explore a World Woven in Death

From fungal forests to bone-strewn deserts, every region pulses with strange life. Discover the stories of those who harvest the dead—like the bone-broker necromancer and the elusive poison-crafting alchemist—while collecting materials to enhance your survival.

Upgrade & Adapt Your Van

Your van isn’t just a vehicle—it’s your lifeline. Upgrade it to travel farther, carry more, and avoid becoming prey. Hover height adapts based on cargo weight, install flares to repel wild beasts, and unlock advanced abilities like gliding and solar recharging to reach previously inaccessible regions.

Scan, Salvage & Survive

Collect rare materials like alien metals, medicinal flowers, and ancient bones. Scan the terrain to uncover hidden resources on your delivery routes, and trade your findings to improve your gear and your chances of survival.

Game Features:

  • A Macabre Delivery Adventure: Transport body parts and other biological oddities via different routes, one grotesque parcel at a time.

  • Customize & Upgrade Your Ride: Expand cargo space, improve hover tech, increase speed, or install life-saving features like refrigerated compartments and flares.

  • An Interconnected World: Learn how plants, animals, and the dead form one pulsing ecosystem.

  • Scan & Scavenge: Explore the wilds for valuable resources, scan unknown lifeforms, and trade your discoveries for vital upgrades.

  • Survive What Lurks Outside: Dangerous creatures roam the terrain so choose your route wisely.

  • Unravel the Lore: Meet strange inhabitants and piece together a dark narrative hidden within your deliveries.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: 4 core CPU
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM; Radeon RX 470, GeForce GTX 970
  • Additional Notes: Does not support Ultra-wide Monitors
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: 6 or 8 core CPU
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM; Radeon RX 470, GeForce GTX 970
  • Additional Notes: Does not support Ultra-wide Monitors
